title: HuBMAP UF TMC - 10x Genomics scRNAseq Modality Overview
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be79jhr6

steps.title: Prepare tissue specimen
steps.instruction: Prepare the chosen organ (spleen, lymph node, or thymus) following the specific protocol linked for each tissue.

steps.title: Register sample in HuBMAP
steps.instruction: Register the completed 10x sample information in the HuBMAP UUID generator at https://uuid.hubmapconsortium.org.

steps.title: Prepare and upload data
steps.instruction: Prepare the 10x data and upload it to the HuBMAP HIVE Globus using the Hipergator system as described in the document HPG 10x (1).docx.

steps.title: Optional: FACS isolate cells
steps.instruction: Optionally, isolate live single cells by FACS for scRNA‑Seq following the protocol at https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfqzjmx6.
